title: aira cespitosa var. pallescens
intro: Aira cespitosa var. pallescens, commonly known as pale hair grass, is a variety of flowering plant in the grass family Poaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties, which help to relieve congestion and coughs. Bioactive constituents of Aira cespitosa var. pallescens include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
